principles: Keep lifecycle story completion and audit backlog semantics separate.
Preserve existing blocking behavior for real active INIT/PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST stories.
Make audit blocking depend on structured evidenceState plus severity, not prose.
Keep the change small and covered by smoke tests.
drivers: B-META-framework-audit is not advanced through story_advance and should not be listed as unfinished story work.
Current convergence output must remain honest: verified high/critical audit findings still block.
The user explicitly scoped out parked/INIT backlog semantics.

options.name: A: Exclude META from story completion and add separate audit backlog check
pros: Makes audit risk visible with structured blocking rules
cons: Adds one more convergence check row and requires smoke coverage for audit findings

options.name: B: Treat META as terminal alongside DONE/DISCARDED
pros: Removes B-META from unfinished story detail
cons: Hides audit backlog entirely from convergence output
Cannot block on verified high/critical audit findings

options.name: C: Resolve or discard B-META container metadata
pros: Could make current convergence pass without code changes
cons: Contradicts audit container design and loses long-lived framework finding history

chosen: A: Exclude META from story completion and add separate audit backlog check
rationale: Option A fixes the semantic mismatch without hiding audit findings or weakening active story completion semantics.

preMortem.scenario: META is excluded and verified high audit findings no longer block
preMortem.trigger: Audit check counts all open findings only as informational
preMortem.consequence: convergence_check can report true despite confirmed severe framework risk
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke a synthetic verified high/critical audit finding and assert the audit check fails

preMortem.scenario: INIT backlog is accidentally excluded with META
preMortem.trigger: Filtering uses broad non-lifecycle or non-active labels instead of exact phase META
preMortem.consequence: real active work stops blocking convergence
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke DONE/DISCARDED/META/INIT together and assert INIT remains in unfinished story detail

preMortem.scenario: Current low/medium audit backlog makes convergence permanently red
preMortem.trigger: Audit check fails for any open audit finding regardless of severity/evidenceState
preMortem.consequence: the repo cannot converge while advisory audit backlog exists
preMortem.mitigation: Block only open verified high/critical findings; include suspected and low/medium nonblocking cases in smoke
